microtheory.name: computational_linguistics
microtheory.definition: Computational + statistical approaches to language. Parsing, tagging, machine translation, information extraction, semantic representation, modern NLP (transformers, embeddings, LLMs). Bridges formal linguistics + computer science. Substrate analogue: the algorithmic substrate processing the substrate's linguistic inputs.

concepts.name: part_of_speech_tagging
concepts.definition: Assign POS tag (noun, verb, etc.) to each word. Often first step in NLP pipeline. HMM, CRF, BERT. Substrate analogue: substrate's lexical-category assignment.

concepts.name: named_entity_recognition
concepts.definition: NER. Identify + classify entities (person, location, organization, date). Substrate analogue: substrate's entity-Concept identification.

concepts.name: dependency_parsing
concepts.definition: Determine head-dependent relations in a sentence. Stanford parser, spaCy. Substrate analogue: substrate's relational structure extraction.

concepts.name: constituency_parsing
concepts.definition: Recover phrase-structure tree. CKY, Earley, neural. Substrate analogue: substrate's compositional tree-extraction.

concepts.name: chart_parsing
concepts.definition: Dynamic programming for ambiguous CFG parsing. CKY algorithm. Substrate analogue: substrate's table-based search.

concepts.name: ngram_model
concepts.definition: Probability of word given previous N-1 words. Markov assumption. Foundational pre-neural LM. Substrate analogue: substrate's local-context probability.

concepts.name: language_model
concepts.definition: Probability distribution over sequences. Used for generation, scoring, completion. Substrate analogue: substrate's predictive distribution over Messages.

concepts.name: smoothing
concepts.definition: Handle zero-probability events in n-gram models. Laplace, Good-Turing, Kneser-Ney. Substrate analogue: substrate's prior over unseen events.

concepts.name: perplexity
concepts.definition: Standard LM evaluation metric. 2^(-log-likelihood-per-word). Lower = better. Substrate analogue: substrate's prediction-quality metric.

concepts.name: word2vec
concepts.definition: Mikolov 2013. Skip-gram + CBOW. Words as dense vectors. Captures distributional + analogical patterns. Substrate analogue: substrate's Concept-as-vector embedding.

concepts.name: glove
concepts.definition: Pennington 2014. Embeddings from global co-occurrence statistics. Substrate analogue: substrate's co-occurrence-derived Concept space.

concepts.name: fasttext
concepts.definition: Bojanowski 2017. Subword embeddings — handles OOV words via character n-grams. Substrate analogue: substrate's morpheme-level Concept representation.

concepts.name: contextual_embeddings
concepts.definition: ELMo, BERT. Word representations depend on context. Polysemy disambiguated. Substrate analogue: substrate's context-conditioned Concept activation.

concepts.name: transformer
concepts.definition: Vaswani 2017. Self-attention based architecture. Foundation of modern NLP. Substrate analogue: substrate's parallel-context attention mechanism.

concepts.name: self_attention
concepts.definition: Each token attends to all others in sequence. Query × Key × Value. Substrate analogue: substrate's all-to-all Concept interaction within Mt.

concepts.name: bert
concepts.definition: Devlin 2018. Bidirectional transformer pre-trained with masked LM + next-sentence prediction. Substrate analogue: substrate's masked-completion learning.

concepts.name: gpt
concepts.definition: Radford 2018+. Decoder-only autoregressive transformer. GPT-2/3/4 = scale. Substrate analogue: substrate's left-to-right generative model.

concepts.name: large_language_model
concepts.definition: LLM. Trained on massive text. Emergent capabilities — in-context learning, chain-of-thought, instruction following. Substrate analogue: substrate's compressed-knowledge accumulation.

concepts.name: machine_translation
concepts.definition: Translate between languages automatically. Rule-based → statistical → neural. Substrate analogue: substrate's cross-Mt translation.

concepts.name: neural_machine_translation
concepts.definition: Seq2seq with attention; now transformer-based. Substrate analogue: substrate's encoder-decoder Mt mapping.

concepts.name: question_answering
concepts.definition: Extract or generate answers from text. Extractive (SQuAD) vs generative. Substrate analogue: substrate's query-resolution from Mt.

concepts.name: summarization
concepts.definition: Compress text to shorter version preserving content. Extractive vs abstractive. Substrate analogue: substrate's compression-objective applied to text.

concepts.name: information_extraction
concepts.definition: Pull structured facts from unstructured text. Relations, events. Substrate analogue: substrate's text-to-graph translation.

concepts.name: sentiment_analysis
concepts.definition: Classify text by emotional valence/intent. Substrate analogue: substrate's affect-attribute extraction from Message.

concepts.name: tokenization
concepts.definition: Split text into units (words, subwords, characters). BPE, WordPiece, SentencePiece. Substrate analogue: substrate's Message-to-lexical-unit segmentation.

concepts.name: subword_tokenization
concepts.definition: BPE merges frequent character pairs; balances vocabulary size with OOV handling. Substrate analogue: substrate's morpheme-level lexical units.

concepts.name: byte_pair_encoding
concepts.definition: BPE. Sennrich 2016. Substrate analogue: substrate's frequency-driven lexical chunking.

concepts.name: attention_mechanism
concepts.definition: Weighted combination of source items based on relevance to query. Bahdanau 2014. Substrate analogue: substrate's context-weighted Concept selection.

concepts.name: cross_attention
concepts.definition: Attention between two sequences. Used in encoder-decoder. Substrate analogue: substrate's cross-Mt attention.

concepts.name: positional_encoding
concepts.definition: Inject sequence position into transformer (which is permutation-invariant otherwise). Substrate analogue: substrate's temporal-position encoding.

concepts.name: few_shot_learning
concepts.definition: Learn from very few examples. LLMs do this in-context. Substrate analogue: substrate's analogical_transfer for rapid generalization.

concepts.name: chain_of_thought
concepts.definition: LLMs reason better when prompted to think step-by-step. Wei 2022. Substrate analogue: substrate's derivation_mechanism explicit walks.

concepts.name: rlhf
concepts.definition: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback. Aligns LLM outputs with human preferences. Substrate analogue: substrate's correction-driven ActionSpec refinement.

rules.name: ngram_models_capture_local_structure
rules.head: the substrate models word sequences with limited context
rules.body: n-gram language models capture local but not long-range structure. Substrate's per-step prediction has the same limitation.

rules.name: distributional_embeddings_capture_meaning
rules.head: the substrate trains embeddings on co-occurrence
rules.body: the resulting vectors capture both similarity (close meanings) + analogy (vector arithmetic). Mikolov 2013. Substrate's distributional Concept-space.

rules.name: contextual_embeddings_disambiguate_polysemy
rules.head: the substrate processes a polysemous word
rules.body: context-dependent embeddings (BERT, etc.) yield different representations for different senses. Substrate's context-conditioned Concept activation.

rules.name: attention_enables_long_range_dependencies
rules.head: the substrate processes long sequences with dependencies between distant elements
rules.body: attention mechanism connects them directly without intervening computation. Substrate's direct all-to-all access.

rules.name: chain_of_thought_improves_reasoning
rules.head: the substrate is asked a complex reasoning question
rules.body: explicitly walking through intermediate steps improves accuracy. Wei 2022. Substrate's derivation_mechanism explicit traversal.
